$comment: Shared VfBreadcrumbs cases. Plain data only. The vocabulary is the native half of the historical Vue contract at fd793696f50d3be0fcd3788f0f8f751c63869963: a nav with an aria-label, an ordered list, one item per entry that is an anchor with href/target/rel or a span, the current-selection and link-selection rules, and an aria-hidden separator after every item but the last whose content a slot replaces. The Vue component's other branch - an item `to`, the root `component`, the RouterLink handoff and the literal unresolved element Vue renders with no router registered - is deliberately absent from this catalog. It is not a cross-platform contract: it is Vue resolving a component by name and passing a destination through untouched, and a Razor target has no router to hand it to. It is pinned by VfBreadcrumbs.characterization.spec.ts and refused by name by the Razor component; the coverage gate refuses it here. componentInteractive is the number of items that render as links under the historical rule - not N-1: the current item, a disabled item and an item with no destination are spans.

propVocabulary.items: VfBreadcrumbItem[], required. Each item: label (string), href (string, an empty string is no destination), target (string, written as given), rel (string, written as given when truthy; otherwise derived as 'noopener noreferrer' for target='_blank' and nothing for any other target), disabled (boolean: a span with the disabled modifier and no aria-disabled), current (boolean: explicit flags are the rule when any item carries one; with none, the last item is current). The current item is always a span; its href is dropped. `to` is Vue-only and refused.
propVocabulary.ariaLabel: string, default 'Breadcrumb'. The nav's aria-label, written even when empty.

slotVocabulary.separator: Replaces the content of the owned aria-hidden separator span after every item but the last. `text` renders the text; `markup: 'label'` wraps it in a consumer span. The Vue scope (item, index) has no Razor counterpart and no case relies on it.

cases.title: Three items: two links and the last item as the current span, with a separator after each link
cases.$why: The shape itself: nav > ol > li x 3, an anchor with href for the first two items, the current span with aria-current=page for the last, and an aria-hidden separator holding the chevron after every item but the last.

cases.title: No items: the nav and the empty list stay, and nothing is current
cases.$why: An empty trail is still a landmark with a list; zero anchors, zero aria-current, zero separators.

cases.title: One item without a destination: the current span alone, no separator
One item with an href: still the current span, its href dropped
cases.$why: The current item is never a link. One item is the last item, so it is current and its href is dropped; zero owned controls although the catalog names a destination.

cases.title: Two links with no explicit current: the last item's href is dropped and it renders as the current span
An explicit current flag on the middle item, so the last item stays a link
cases.$why: The explicit flag is the rule when any item carries one: the middle span carries aria-current=page and the last item is an anchor.

cases.title: Two explicit current flags: two current spans, two aria-current attributes, one link
cases.$why: The reference never enforces one current item. A target that collapsed the second flag would differ on dom.aria and dom.structure.

cases.title: A disabled middle item: a span with the disabled modifier, no aria-current, no aria-disabled, its href dropped
A disabled last item: the span carries both the disabled modifier and aria-current=page
A middle item with no destination: a span with the current class and no aria-current
An empty-string href is no destination: the item is a span, not an anchor with an empty href
cases.$why: Where the component differs from VfLink, which keeps href="" on its anchor. The owned selector carries [href], so an anchor with an empty href would be counted and the budget of one would fail.

cases.title: target=_blank with no rel derives rel="noopener noreferrer"
target=_blank with an explicit rel writes the explicit value without merging
target=_self derives no rel
rel without target is written on its own
An empty label renders an empty anchor, a link with no name
Two links to the same destination render as two anchors
The ariaLabel prop names the nav
ariaLabel="" writes an empty aria-label attribute rather than restoring the default
A consumer class after the block class, plus style, id and a product data attribute on the nav - and on nothing inside it
Consumer ARIA on the nav: a description that resolves outside it, and a title
A text separator from the slot, inside the owned aria-hidden wrapper after every item but the last
Consumer markup as the separator: a span inside the owned wrapper
A five-item trail: four links and the current span
